raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Update Transformer Engine from `2.20.2+44f31bbe` to `2.21.0+7457e47d`, pinning the requested `release_v2.21` tip: NVIDIA/TransformerEngine@7457e47d26d9d02dfb783007335dfbe75e1b90a8. Resolved on 2026-10-30 and rechecked unchanged on 2026-10-31. Target: `core_r0.20.0`, base `bc4341d62d`.

Regenerate `uv.lock` in the pinned PyTorch 26.09 container with uv 0.12.1. All 305 unrelated package records, NCCL extensions, and dev/LTS image pins remain unchanged.

TE 2.21's `LayerNormLinear` returns gathered-size dummy weight gradients for layer-sharded optimizer parameters. Apply a Python-only dev-image patch that sizes them from the local parameter, matching TE's existing `Linear` implementation. Include the patch in image cache inputs and retain its build provenance. Existing dense and MoE optimizer parity tests reproduced the unpatched shape failures (`[512,256]` versus `[256,256]`, and `[384,256]` versus `[192,256]`); both execute and pass with the patch, with bitwise-identical eight-step losses. The requested TE source pin is retained.

Refresh the justified H100 and GB300 scoped CUDA-graph references. Exact-base old-TE controls pass five regular/checkpoint-resume repetitions against the original references. Completed new-TE attempts are finite and repeat-identical, approximate numerical checks pass, and resumed tails match uninterrupted training. The three GitHub H100 attempts also match the three GitLab H100 attempts bitwise. Production-comparator CPU replay passes against the new H100 reference.

Signed reference differences are `100 × mean((old − new) / old)`; positive means new is lower:

| Scoped CUDA graphs / dev | Loss | MTP loss | Gradient zeros | Allocated memory* | Peak memory* | Iteration time* |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| H100 | +0.000440% | +0.000452% | −0.090502% | +0.423482% | +1.125164% | +35.077455% |
| GB300 | −0.000530% | +0.000276% | +0.088077% | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged |

100 shared samples per metric, except iteration time (99); no added or removed samples and no nonfinite values. **Only loss, MTP loss, and gradient zeros are configured comparisons in this recipe.** Memory/timing are collected only: these deltas are not resource-validation or performance claims. The legacy H100 file requires full-file precision migration, including its unused resource blocks. GB300 resource reference blocks are preserved. Collected GB300 source observations versus the reference were −0.103289% allocated memory, −0.022254% peak memory (100 samples each), and +2.991583% iteration time (99 samples); these fields were neither refreshed nor compared. All tolerances, assertions, and test selection markers remain unchanged.

Nemotron frozen-start GB200 reference refresh, explicitly requested after baseline comparison:
- Source: [completed job 124495131072](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/41179623655/job/124495131072), artifact `13037317199`. Updated only `nemotron3_5_lightning_no_load_optim_tp1_pp1_cp1_ep4_dgx_gb200_1N4G/golden_values_dev_dgx_gb200.json`.
- All six compared curves match all three complete 20-step attempts and the exact-base TE 2.20 control bitwise. The update corrects the pre-existing reference mismatch; it is not evidence of TE-induced drift.
- Production comparator replay passed for all three attempts. Full-precision/nonfinite validation and `git diff --check` passed. No tolerances, model settings, or test selections changed.
- Nemotron-reference revision `1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95` was a one-file golden-only change after the full-CI revision below. [GitHub CI41218590716](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/41218590716) completed successfully on that revision. Current head is `3b1d101a4472fe4b823c972ffdbb296f615fb36a`, including the observer-lifetime backport below; the targeted current-head GRPO GPU validation below passed. Broader current-head CI remains a separate validation scope.

Signed differences use `100 × mean((old − new) / old)`; positive means new is lower:

| Nemotron metric | Signed difference | Shared steps |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| lm loss | −0.000297% | 20 |
| MTP 1 loss | −0.001319% | 20 |
| MTP 2 loss | −0.002103% | 20 |
| Gradient zeros | −0.044465% | 20 |
| Allocated memory | +0.000012% | 20 |
| Peak allocated memory | +11.919393% | 20 |
| Iteration time (collected, not compared) | −8.212433% | 19 |

No added/removed samples, excluded zero denominators, or nonfinite values. The peak-memory reference correction is large and also present in the old-TE control; iteration time is an observation, not a performance claim.

### CUDA-graph saved-tensor observer backport

Cherry-pick [#8850](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8850), source commit `f18c3fc1ce1e002bdf0f7de2258e786c9241dd28`, as signed/signed-off commit `3b1d101a4472fe4b823c972ffdbb296f615fb36a`. Forward-only GRPO old/reference-logprob passes can request graph creation before any training graphs are recorded. The empty-create path now retains the saved-tensor observer until actual capture; capture success/failure still restores it.

The production hunk applies unchanged. Backport the four new observer tests and the packed-sequence GPU regression change. Omit only the two fixture adjustments to main's unrelated failed-capture cleanup test, which does not exist on this release branch.

Validation: execute the exact observer/metadata source definitions and upstream test class on CPU in the pinned PyTorch26.09 base. The pre-backport revision reproduces **2 failures /2 passes**; the backport passes **all4 tests**. The new test class matches upstream's AST exactly. Black, isort and diff checks pass. Local GPU execution is unavailable because NVML reports a driver/library mismatch. These focused CPU checks were followed by the original GPU GRPO validation below; the GPU evidence, rather than the CPU checks alone, supports the result.

### Targeted GRPO GPU validation — 2026-11-03: PASS

The original `gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_cudagraphs_throughput` case passes on head `3b1d101a4472fe4b823c972ffdbb296f615fb36a` after the observer-lifetime backport. GPU job525815591 and its parent/child pipelines completed successfully; the full run record is in AUT-2708.

- Original dev/H100 recipe: one node/eight GPUs, seed42, checkpoint iteration1,20 training steps and one recipe repetition. Lightweight mode off; no diagnostic source patch, checkpoint-selector override, golden change or tolerance change.
- Runtime source hashes match this PR head and imported TE reports `2.21.0+7457e47d`. The validated native image is unchanged; current PR source is fetched at runtime.
- Captured **72 training CUDA graphs**. All **20/20 loss and gradient-norm samples are finite**, with **zero NaN iterations and zero skipped iterations**. Gradient norms range from0 to2.5892112255;9 samples are nonzero.
- All eight rank stderr logs are free of the prior local-gradient NaN signature.
- The original production `test_grpo_training_loop` comparator **passes**, including its configured allocated-memory, peak-memory and iteration-time checks. No reference was refreshed for this result.

The historical NaN is **not reproduced in this original20-step validation after the fix**. This is one configured repetition of this case, not a full-suite or fleet-wide correctness claim.

Detailed prior-revision full CI results for head `85af4990766ac597f55600fc7b1dfb15d6004f59` (2026-10-31; predates the Nemotron reference refresh):

- New-head GitLab results: all 18 added H100 nightly cases passed, both Blackwell pilots passed five 50-step repeats and five production comparator checks each, and all 43 cases in the added GB300 batch passed. GB200's added 43-case matrix completed with 42 passed and the deferred-wgrad failure below; deferred embedding wgrad job `520565819` fails its reference, but all 100 regular and 50 resumed loss/gradient-zero values match exact-base old-TE control `519937020` bitwise. Preserve that pre-existing failing reference. H100 scoped-CG MR revalidation passed all five 100-step regular/50-step resumed repetitions, 750 training steps and ten production comparator checks; its full pipeline is green.
- [New full GitHub run](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/41179623655): L1, five repeats requested with model overrides respected, lightweight mode off, selective unit testing off. Verified test merge `56a5e4ddab` has parents `bc4341d62d` and `85af499076`. Test environment approved. All 43 unit buckets passed on this head, including all eight previously near-threshold FP32 mHC variants. Broad H100: 3,407 tests and 19 subtests passed, plus two 24-test follow-ups; broad GB200: 285 passed / 64 skipped / 742 deselected. Gated delta-net: 162 passed / 37 skipped. The actual functional matrix matches all 80 H100 and 32 GB200 selections. GB200 finished with 31 passed and the Nemotron baseline failure: all six curves from three current-head 20-step attempts match the exact-base old-TE control bitwise. H100 scoped CUDA graphs passed all five regular/resume repetitions, 750 training iterations and ten production comparator checks against the refreshed reference. All 80 H100 functional cases passed. The workflow completed with 179 terminal jobs; its only numerical failure is the baseline-identical Nemotron case, and `Nemo_CICD_Test` reports the resulting aggregate failure. CODEOWNERS and multi-approval checks still require human review. These use the existing CI clusters/accounts and original recipes, repeats, time limits, and comparisons, with offline W&B logging. The pinned native image is from `f166d1abee`; the only subsequent source change is the H100 golden file, and GPU workloads explicitly fetch `85af499076`. User GitLab credentials are confined to control-plane requests.
- Lock consistency, unrelated-package comparison, Docker/workflow checks, clean patch application and compilation, CPU autograd regression reproduction, golden validation, comparator replay, diff checks, and commit signatures passed. No final-head GPU pass is inferred from earlier revisions.

All healthy-platform nightly case names have now executed across the two revisions (training code and nightly recipe/reference inputs are unchanged between them):

| Nightly platform | Passed | Baseline/reference failures | Cases executed |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| H100 | 31 | 2 | 33/33 |
| GB200 | 64 | 5 | 69/69 |
| GB300 | 67 | 2 | 69/69 |

These totals combine `f166d1abee` (15 H100 / 25 per Blackwell platform) and `85af499076` (18 H100 / 44 per Blackwell platform); they are not a literal all-final-head GitLab run. A100 remains unavailable.

Earlier published code revision `f166d1abee`:

- [Full GitHub run](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/41143349423): all 43 unit buckets passed (40 H100, 3 GB200). Broad buckets: H100 3,407 passed / 142 skipped / 134 deselected plus 19 subtests; GB200 285 passed / 64 skipped / 742 platform-deselected. Functional results: H100 79/80 passed, with the scoped-CG reference failure now addressed; GB200 31/32 passed, with the pre-existing Nemotron failure below.
- GitLab MR `78043314`: H100 135 passed, two failed, two cancelled across 139 cases; GB200 19 passed and two failed across 21. The separate H100 scoped-CG probe completed three stable regular/resume attempts before its reference refresh. Cancelled GPT-OSS and GRPO wrappers retain their actual failed attempts and are not passes.
- Nightly coverage was partial: 15/33 H100 and 25/69 on each Blackwell platform. GB300 scoped-CG validation passed all five regular/resume repeats. Coverage spans revisions; full final-head GitLab coverage is not established.
- Eight FP32 mHC variants passed in this run. An earlier revision had near-tolerance failures (maximum absolute error `1.0548159e-5`, limit `1e-5`); its cause is unresolved. Settings and tolerances were not changed.

**GRPO correctness finding: original GPU case passes after the observer-lifetime backport.** Before the backport, case `gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_cudagraphs_throughput` produced NaN local gradient norms before data-parallel communication in three complete MR attempts. The subsequent `checkpoints_path=None` exception is a secondary diagnostic-save error. The [exact-base old-TE control](https://gitlab-master.nvidia.com/ADLR/megatron-lm/-/pipelines/78066988), TE 2.20.2, loaded the same actor checkpoint, completed all 20 iterations, and passed `test_grpo_training_loop` (the recipe overrides repeats to one).


Other failures and coverage limits:

| Case | Evidence and disposition |
| --- | --- |
| GB200 Nemotron frozen-start | [Exact-base GitHub control](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/41166282901/job/124462439393) loaded the same checkpoint. All six curves match all three current-source attempts bitwise across 20 steps. Reference refreshed at the user's request in `1e05abca4b`; all three production comparator replays pass and GitHub CI41218590716 subsequently passed that revision. The targeted GRPO validation passes the later observer-fix head; it does not replace separate Nemotron/full-suite validation. The earlier checkpoint-missing GitLab control is invalid and excluded. |
| H100 T5-11B and BERT TP4 | Exact-base old-TE controls reproduce all compared loss, gradient-zero, and memory values bitwise against three new-TE attempts (25 and 50 steps respectively). Preserve references, including T5's large existing loss mismatch. |
| Blackwell FSDP-v1 / EP8, GB200 A2A / deferred wgrad | Old/new numerical curves are bitwise equal for the classified failures. Preserve references. GB200 scoped-CG also fails old-TE reference checks with small finite old/new drift; no refresh. |
| GB200 FSDP-v2 / hybrid performance | FSDP-v2 repeats the baseline-failing metrics and matches initial new-TE raw curves. Hybrid performance fails in both versions, with observed old/new TPOT differences up to +8.85% and throughput down up to 8.13%; attribution is unresolved, so preserve its reference. |
| H100 inference outputs | FP8/SwiGLU first diagnostics match baseline failures. GPT-OSS has repeat-varying failures in both versions: both new first-reported outputs occur among old attempts. This does not establish all-prompt equivalence; preserve token references. |
| A100 / incidental LTS | Repeated missing shared dataset mount (`tokens-shuffle`) prevents training. No unchanged retry or LTS pin update; unavailable lanes are not validated. |
| NCCL EP MXFP8 wire | Both TE versions skip the path because this source lacks `mxfp8_carrier_to_grouped`; skips are not coverage. |

The observer-lifetime fix from #8850 is now backported and the original GRPO CUDA-graph case passes on the current head. This resolves the targeted validation gap for that finding; other CI and review requirements remain separate. A100 remains unvalidated; the known baseline failures, skipped paths, mixed-revision GitLab coverage, and human-review requirements above remain outstanding. No quarantine or tolerance/precision change has been applied.

Contributors can view more details about this message [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/auto-sync).

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

The TE update still carries the reported GRPO training-CUDA-graph NaN regression described below.

I reviewed all eight changed files and their directly affected build, gradient, and functional-comparison paths. I found no additional light-review issues. Existing dense/MoE parity tests cover the GTP shape fix, and the golden updates retain their configured comparisons.

This was a static review. I couldn't execute tests, inspect the external TE implementation, or independently verify the linked CI artifacts.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

<!-- nemo-ci-review-rendering:inline-v1 -->
<!-- nemo-ci-formal-review:05a82626fc22413f6f2d6641fb270a66aba38fceadd66eafdf531b292c40e029:f444dc8f710eeb7a9221bb38b9045b8f528a3543f641f870a53b366d09d5fec0 -->

Resolve the GRPO training-graph NaNs before advancing the TE pin.

**Failure:** The PR reports three complete TE 2.21 attempts of `gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_cudagraphs_throughput` producing NaN local gradient norms, while the exact-base TE 2.20.2 control loads the same actor checkpoint, completes 20 iterations, and passes validation. I haven't independently replayed those runs. The current [H100 MR recipe](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/tests/test_utils/recipes/h100/gpt-grpo.yaml#L75-L79) still selects this case, and its [configuration](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/tests/functional_tests/test_cases/gpt/gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_cudagraphs_throughput/model_config.yaml#L89-L111) still enables local training graphs and the 20-iteration budget. The [gradient guard](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/megatron/core/distributed/param_and_grad_buffer.py#L402-L426) rejects these NaNs before data-parallel communication. Fixing only the subsequent diagnostic-save exception wouldn't restore training.

**Correction:** Include a focused TE/Megatron compatibility fix for the capture/backward path used by `--rl-training-cuda-graphs` before advancing this dependency. The external TE implementation and failing artifacts aren't available here, so I can't identify a safe replacement patch. The invariant to restore is finite local gradients throughout capture and replay with the unchanged checkpoint and recipe, without suppressing NaN validation.

**Preservation and proposed acceptance checks:**
- Run the named H100 case with its existing Qwen3-8B checkpoint, seed 42, TP4/DP2 topology, sequence packing, graph flags, and comparisons. Expect all 20 iterations to complete with finite local gradients and `test_grpo_training_loop` to pass; repeat the run to check the reported repeatability.
- Retain the neighboring [non-training-graph throughput case](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/tests/functional_tests/test_cases/gpt/gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_throughput/model_config.yaml#L89-L115) and `gpt_grpo_basic_function`: both must still complete and pass their existing validators.
- Preserve the GTP repair: the existing [dense and MoE layer-sharded parity tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/tests/unit_tests/optimizer/test_layer_sharded_e2e_parity.py#L113-L177) must retain finite, bitwise-identical eight-step losses between duplicated and layer-sharded modes.

These are proposed checks, not results from this review.

| H100 | 31 | 2 | 33/33 |
| GB200 | 64 | 5 | 69/69 |
| GB300 | 67 | 2 | 69/69 |

These totals combine `f166d1abee` (15 H100 / 25 per Blackwell platform) and `85af499076` (18 H100 / 44 per Blackwell platform); they are not a literal all-final-head GitLab run. A100 remains unavailable.

Earlier published code revision `f166d1abee`:

- [Full GitHub run](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/41143349423): all 43 unit buckets passed (40 H100, 3 GB200). Broad buckets: H100 3,407 passed / 142 skipped / 134 deselected plus 19 subtests; GB200 285 passed / 64 skipped / 742 platform-deselected. Functional results: H100 79/80 passed, with the scoped-CG reference failure now addressed; GB200 31/32 passed, with the pre-existing Nemotron failure below.
- GitLab MR `78043314`: H100 135 passed, two failed, two cancelled across 139 cases; GB200 19 passed and two failed across 21. The separate H100 scoped-CG probe completed three stable regular/resume attempts before its reference refresh. Cancelled GPT-OSS and GRPO wrappers retain their actual failed attempts and are not passes.
- Nightly coverage was partial: 15/33 H100 and 25/69 on each Blackwell platform. GB300 scoped-CG validation passed all five regular/resume repeats. Coverage spans revisions; full final-head GitLab coverage is not established.
- Eight FP32 mHC variants passed in this run. An earlier revision had near-tolerance failures (maximum absolute error `1.0548159e-5`, limit `1e-5`); its cause is unresolved. Settings and tolerances were not changed.

**GRPO correctness finding: original GPU case passes after the observer-lifetime backport.** Before the backport, case `gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_cudagraphs_throughput` produced NaN local gradient norms before data-parallel communication in three complete MR attempts. The subsequent `checkpoints_path=None` exception is a secondary diagnostic-save error. The [exact-base old-TE control](https://gitlab-master.nvidia.com/ADLR/megatron-lm/-/pipelines/78066988), TE 2.20.2, loaded the same actor checkpoint, completed all 20 iterations, and passed `test_grpo_training_loop` (the recipe overrides repeats to one).


Other failures and coverage limits:

| Case | Evidence and disposition |
| --- | --- |
| GB200 Nemotron frozen-start | [Exact-base GitHub control](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/41166282901/job/124462439393) loaded the same checkpoint. All six curves match all three current-source attempts bitwise across 20 steps. Reference refreshed at the user's request in `1e05abca4b`; all three production comparator replays pass and GitHub CI41218590716 subsequently passed that revision. The targeted GRPO validation passes the later observer-fix head; it does not replace separate Nemotron/full-suite validation. The earlier checkpoint-missing GitLab control is invalid and excluded. |
| H100 T5-11B and BERT TP4 | Exact-base old-TE controls reproduce all compared loss, gradient-zero, and memory values bitwise against three new-TE attempts (25 and 50 steps respectively). Preserve references, including T5's large existing loss mismatch. |
| Blackwell FSDP-v1 / EP8, GB200 A2A / deferred wgrad | Old/new numerical curves are bitwise equal for the classified failures. Preserve references. GB200 scoped-CG also fails old-TE reference checks with small finite old/new drift; no refresh. |
| GB200 FSDP-v2 / hybrid performance | FSDP-v2 repeats the baseline-failing metrics and matches initial new-TE raw curves. Hybrid performance fails in both versions, with observed old/new TPOT differences up to +8.85% and throughput down up to 8.13%; attribution is unresolved, so preserve its reference. |
| H100 inference outputs | FP8/SwiGLU first diagnostics match baseline failures. GPT-OSS has repeat-varying failures in both versions: both new first-reported outputs occur among old attempts. This does not establish all-prompt equivalence; preserve token references. |
| A100 / incidental LTS | Repeated missing shared dataset mount (`tokens-shuffle`) prevents training. No unchanged retry or LTS pin update; unavailable lanes are not validated. |
| NCCL EP MXFP8 wire | Both TE versions skip the path because this source lacks `mxfp8_carrier_to_grouped`; skips are not coverage. |

The observer-lifetime fix from #8850 is now backported and the original GRPO CUDA-graph case passes on the current head. This resolves the targeted validation gap for that finding; other CI and review requirements remain separate. A100 remains unvalidated; the known baseline failures, skipped paths, mixed-revision GitLab coverage, and human-review requirements above remain outstanding. No quarantine or tolerance/precision change has been applied.

+class TestCudaGraphSavedTensorObserver:
+    @pytest.fixture
+    def record(self):
+        # Exercise the real observer without sharing the process-global graph records.
+        class Record(_CudagraphGlobalRecord):
+            cudagraph_created = False
+            cudagraph_record = []
+            _saved_tensors_observer = None
+
+        original_save = torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx.save_for_backward
+        try:
+            yield Record
+        finally:
+            Record._disable_saved_tensors_observer()
+            assert torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx.save_for_backward is original_save
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("save_view", [False, True])
+    def test_empty_create_preserves_observer_for_later_training(self, record, save_view):
+        record._enable_saved_tensors_observer()
+        observing_save = torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx.save_for_backward
+
+        # GRPO computes old/reference logprobs with forward-only schedules before
+        # its first training forward records any CUDA graphs.
+        for _ in range(2):
+            assert record.create_cudagraphs() is None
+            assert record._saved_tensors_observer is not None
+            assert torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx.save_for_backward is observing_save
+
+        class SaveInput(torch.autograd.Function):
+            @staticmethod
+            def forward(ctx, value):
+                # TE 2.20 saves an input view; TE 2.21 saves the input directly.
+                ctx.save_for_backward(value.view(-1, 3) if save_view else value)
+                return value * 2
+
+            @staticmethod
+            def backward(ctx, grad_output):
+                return grad_output * 2
+
+        value = torch.ones(2, 3, requires_grad=True)
+        output = SaveInput.apply(value)
+        assert value.cg_buffer_metadata.is_saved_for_backward
+        assert (output.grad_fn.saved_tensors[0] is value) is not save_view
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("capture_fails", [False, True])
+    def test_capture_restores_observer_on_success_or_failure(
+        self, record, monkeypatch, capture_fails
+    ):
+        original_save = torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx.save_for_backward
+        record._enable_saved_tensors_observer()
+        observing_save = torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx.save_for_backward
+        record.cudagraph_record = [object()]
+        capture_stats = {"time": 1.0}
+
+        def capture(cls):
+            assert torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx.save_for_backward is observing_save
+            value = torch.ones(2, 3)
+            torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx().save_for_backward(value)
+            assert value.cg_buffer_metadata.is_saved_for_backward
+            if capture_fails:
+                raise RuntimeError("capture failed")
+            cls.cudagraph_created = True
+            cls.cudagraph_record = []
+            return capture_stats
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(record, "_create_cudagraphs", classmethod(capture))
+        if capture_fails:
+            with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="capture failed"):
+                record.create_cudagraphs()
+        else:
+            assert record.create_cudagraphs() is capture_stats
+
+        assert record._saved_tensors_observer is None
+        assert torch.autograd.function.FunctionCtx.save_for_backward is original_save

inline_comments.body:
Resolve the GRPO training-graph NaNs before advancing the TE pin.

**Failure:** The PR reports three complete TE 2.21 attempts of `gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_cudagraphs_throughput` producing NaN local gradient norms, while the exact-base TE 2.20.2 control loads the same actor checkpoint, completes 20 iterations, and passes validation. I haven't independently replayed those runs. The current [H100 MR recipe](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/tests/test_utils/recipes/h100/gpt-grpo.yaml#L75-L79) still selects this case, and its [configuration](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/tests/functional_tests/test_cases/gpt/gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_cudagraphs_throughput/model_config.yaml#L89-L111) still enables local training graphs and the 20-iteration budget. The [gradient guard](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/megatron/core/distributed/param_and_grad_buffer.py#L402-L426) rejects these NaNs before data-parallel communication. Fixing only the subsequent diagnostic-save exception wouldn't restore training.

**Correction:** Include a focused TE/Megatron compatibility fix for the capture/backward path used by `--rl-training-cuda-graphs` before advancing this dependency. The external TE implementation and failing artifacts aren't available here, so I can't identify a safe replacement patch. The invariant to restore is finite local gradients throughout capture and replay with the unchanged checkpoint and recipe, without suppressing NaN validation.

**Preservation and proposed acceptance checks:**
- Run the named H100 case with its existing Qwen3-8B checkpoint, seed 42, TP4/DP2 topology, sequence packing, graph flags, and comparisons. Expect all 20 iterations to complete with finite local gradients and `test_grpo_training_loop` to pass; repeat the run to check the reported repeatability.
- Retain the neighboring [non-training-graph throughput case](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/tests/functional_tests/test_cases/gpt/gpt_grpo_tp4_pp1_dp2_8b_throughput/model_config.yaml#L89-L115) and `gpt_grpo_basic_function`: both must still complete and pass their existing validators.
- Preserve the GTP repair: the existing [dense and MoE layer-sharded parity tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/1e05abca4b3ca2585941fbda38ee8dcb619beb95/tests/unit_tests/optimizer/test_layer_sharded_e2e_parity.py#L113-L177) must retain finite, bitwise-identical eight-step losses between duplicated and layer-sharded modes.

These are proposed checks, not results from this review.
